pitch=introductory.displayTitle: Introductory: what you can do, level by level
pitch=introductory.instruction: This introductory course builds across 3 levels. Open each to see what it means in practice.

_items.title: L3 — Explain what generative AI is and is not
_items.body: You can explain what generative AI is, and what it is not.
_items.advice: In practice, this means you can explain what generative AI is, and what it is not.

_items.title: L4 — Check the assessment guidance before using AI
_items.body: You check your assessment guidance before using AI on a task.
_items.advice: In practice, this means you check your assessment guidance before using AI on a task.

_items.title: L5 — Recognise what AI cannot be trusted for, and think first
_items.body: You recognise what AI can't be trusted to do, and think it through yourself first.
